description: Conservatively assess one explicit factual claim against official SEC filing evidence and return support, contradiction, mixed, partial, or insufficient-evidence stance signals. Use this when the caller already has a proposition to test. Use filedproof.search_evidence for open-ended research, filedproof.reconcile_financial_fact for one supported standalone-quarter revenue, net-income, or operating-cash-flow value, or filedproof.check_disclosure_changes for new disclosure-change monitoring. A filing establishes what the company reported, not independent real-world truth.

claim.description: The factual claim to assess against the company's SEC filings.

filings.description: Maximum number of filings to inspect for this invocation.

forms.description: SEC forms to search. Defaults to 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K.

history.description: Whether to use bounded historical SEC submission archives when needed.

identifier.description: Ticker, CIK, or exact SEC company name.

item.description: Optional SEC filing item such as 1A or 7.

limit.description: Maximum number of operation-specific evidence or result records to return.

name: filedproof.verify_claim

outputSchema.description: Structured FiledProof result with operation-specific evidence, provenance, coverage, and uncertainty fields.

title: Verify a claim against SEC filings
